component.name: OpenXplorer
component.summary: Explorer-style local and SMB file manager

description.p: Browse local files and SMB shares in a tabbed interface with light and dark appearances, a resizable sidebar, indexed filename search and read-only ZIP browsing.

This stable release provides connected network locations, searchable Settings, tab-to-window movement and opt-in Show in folder integration for Zorin desktops. Installation does not change file associations, browser preferences or network mounts.
Add opt-in in-app updates and fix folder permission preservation, backup protection, keyboard activation, tab navigation, cached search and device ZIP extraction.
Add explicit Replace or Skip conflict handling and fix transfers to connected phones that do not support Unix permission changes.
Show connected Android, camera/PTP and iPhone devices in the sidebar and This PC, with native GIO browsing and hot-plug refresh.

First stable release. Middle-click folders to open tabs in the background, tear tabs out onto the desktop and merge them back across windows, extract ZIP archives and open terminals in the current folder. Existing defaults remain unchanged until requested.
